properties.name: The ility report is bounded, after the design's own growth carried it past the cap
properties.rationale: Caught by tools/replies_are_bounded.py during an ordinary gate run on 2026-09-20. Not planned work: the session's own records grew the design past 30,000 characters.
properties.summary: coherence.rs: ility_report takes the shared budget request and bounds its reply by sampling; service.rs: the empty request struct it used is removed. Plus a test pinning that the per-capability build question stays silent while nothing is built.
